about: The owner's settled decisions, each with the words that name it. A reply that asks about one of these is refused by the end-of-reply check and shown the answer; the owner can reopen one by raising it themselves. Rule 5 of the project instructions: don't re-ask anything already settled. Sources: controls/START-HERE.md (approved 13 Oct 2026), controls/PROJECT-INSTRUCTIONS.md, controls/config.json, docs/PREVIEW-FOR-YOU.md and the session records in records/.
how_it_matches: words = the decision's distinctive subject words; also = helper words (figures, directions). A sentence touches a decision when at least one distinctive word is in it and two words in all are. Add a decision in the same reply the owner makes it.

settled.answer: Text column 1220 wide.
Beige line between sections: 30 above, 30 below. A beige line before and after every quotation, 30 from the letters.
Navy footer band 40 above and below; the footer quotation and its attribution 18px.
Hero and top pictures 1600 wide.
Text justified on computers (641px and wider), no hyphenation; phones left-aligned. Quotations, captions, tab lines and lists are not justified.
The "Table of contents" title stands alone on its own line above the columns.
Between paragraphs 20.
Under a heading 20. Above a heading 30, including a heading directly under another heading.
Bold sub-heading: 30 above, 12 to its text.
List lines 15 apart; 30 above and below a list; a one-line list that finishes its sentence 14 above. Bulleted lists indented one tab (48) on computers; numbered lists at the margin; phones no indent.
Quotations 18px, lines 23 apart; 25 into and out of a quotation; first line and attribution indented one tab (48).
Rows of photos 30 above and below.

Photos in a grid or beside text 120 high, centred on their text; rows stay 168; a single photo beside a paragraph takes the paragraph's height, up to 168. On phones photos stand one under another, centred.
Category titles (for example The Mathematics Curriculum) are blue, and nothing in the menu is bold.
Leading entries (the first line of a group when it is the section's own page, for example Administration in the Play, Administration, Parents and Resources panels) are blue too.
On phones the titles are the light blue #8FC6FF.

Essay pages: the live page https://montessorimentor.co.uk/the-practical-life-curriculum-2/ is the template. Resources pages: the live page https://montessorimentor.co.uk/practical-life-resources/ is the template. Temporary, until the numbers-only template is made (planned 14 Oct 2026).
One page at a time.

settled.topic: Page text is the owner's words
settled.answer: Page text comes from your Word documents word for word; I never write wording for your pages. Exception: correct all typos.
Faces: blurring only where you ask, and never for the 11 September documents.
Your originals (Word files, PDFs, photos) are never edited; I work on copies.
Letters to letters = the line the letters sit on to the top of the capitals below. Tails of g, y and p are ignored. The owner's definition, 13 Oct 2026; measure_mode baseline_to_capheight, confirmed.

settled.topic: How often the places are searched
settled.answer: In every reply, every place, before anything is written or changed. The owner's instructions, and the owner's decision of 14 Oct 2026 ("I want all of them": search first, with the owner's words, quote what is found).

settled.topic: The wording check reports, it does not block
settled.answer: Since 14 October 2026 (your decision) the wording check reports instead of blocking: every word that differs from the Word file is listed in the reply.

settled.topic: Places a cloud session never offers
settled.answer: Chats, Project, Memory (project notes), Account memory and preferences and Folders are not offered in a cloud session; they are recorded as not offered. No repository setting can make them appear; the first four are features of the claude.ai chat app and the fifth needs the owner's computer linked.
